source: arXiv:2511.12490 — Discovery of a 13-Sharpe OOS Factor: Drift Regimes Unlock Hidden Cross-Sectional Predictability (November 2025)
title: H308 stub — Drift-Regime Gated Value+Reversal stock selection
rationale:
arXiv:2511.12490 (Nov 2025) documents a cross-sectional equity factor with OOS Sharpe > 13 (L/S, daily rebalance). The mechanism is disarmingly simple: combine value + short-term reversal signals ONLY during stock-specific 'drift regimes' defined as periods when a stock has >60% positive days in a trailing 63-calendar-day window. In non-drift periods, hold cash. This regime gate is purely price-based (no ML, no external data), deterministic, and easy to backtest. 

Relevance to our pipeline: 
- H181 (industry-adjusted short-term reversal) CONFIRMED OOS. H181 applies reversal unconditionally. Adding the drift regime gate is a direct upgrade path.
- H284 (FCF/P value, CONFIRMED weak) uses FMP fundamentals. Value blended with drift-gated reversal could improve.
- H228 (alpha101+H181 blend, CONFIRMED OOS 1.572) is our strongest stock-picking signal. Drift gating as a post-filter layer could further improve Sharpe.

For long-only adaptation:
- Paper's 13-Sharpe is long/short + daily rebalance. Long-only monthly rebalance will compress dramatically.
- Conservative OOS gate: 1.3 (our best stock-picking is H217 at 1.559, H228 at 1.572).
- Expected range: 0.9–1.5 for long-only; if it hits 1.3+ it earns a portfolio slot.

Design:
- Universe: S&P 500 proxy (200–500 stocks from Polygon free tier, same methodology as H181)
- Drift regime: per stock, trailing 45 trading days, % positive-close-days > 0.60
- Value signal: trailing 12-month FCF/P from FMP (quarterly update, forward-filled)
- Reversal signal: trailing 5-day return (buy negative = reversal)
- Combined score: when drift=1, score = rank(FCF/P) + rank(-5d_ret); when drift=0, score = NaN (excluded)
- Portfolio: top 20 drift-active stocks by combined score, equal-weight, monthly rebalance
- Variants A/B/C: pure drift+reversal / drift+value only / drift+reversal+H181-industry-adj
- IS: 2010–2019, OOS: 2020–2026
- Gate: OOS Sharpe > 1.3

content.hypothesis: Combining FCF/P value signal + short-term reversal signal activated ONLY during stock-specific drift regimes (>60% positive days in trailing 45-trading-day window). Long-only, top-20 stocks, monthly rebalance. Gate: OOS Sharpe > 1.3.

content.key_risk: Paper's 13-Sharpe is L/S + daily rebalance. Long-only + monthly rebalance compresses Sharpe substantially. Drift regime gate may create adverse selection (only buy drifting stocks, missing recovery plays). Also: drift regime on monthly lookback may reduce universe to very few stocks — check for 'no candidates' months.
